integrity: Exact hull, all-content saturation threshold and singleton gcd hole law have self-contained proofs; finite computation is only corroboration. Published singleton achievable-deck count is credited as prior work.
scientific_limitations: Three labeled symbols, positive multiplicities and full length-two scattered decks only. Convex-hull lattice saturation is not polytope normality. The 2026 motivating preprint full text was not available for priority comparison; some unindexed prior formulations might exist.
title: Integer saturation threshold and exact lattice-hole law for ternary two-decks
